answer_1.quote: We propose a simple data augmentation method SIMPLEAUG... questions annotated for one image can be valuable add-ons to other relevant images and design a series of mechanisms to "propagate" questions from one image to the others.
answer_1.outputs: augmented image-question-answer (IQA) triplets generated by propagating existing questions to other images and by paraphrasing similar questions

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 500 images and pick 5 augmented QA pairs per image... we ask 5 different crowd workers to evaluate "relatedness (1/0)" of the augmented questions and "correctness (1/0)" of the answer given the question and image.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators judge whether the generated question is related to the image and whether the provided answer is correct.
